Privacy Policy for Classroom Copier

Last Updated: November 5, 2026

1. Introduction

Welcome to Classroom Copier ("we," "our," or "us"). We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting the information you share with us when using our web application to duplicate and manage Google Classroom courses and related Google Drive resources.

2. Information We Access and Collect

Classroom Copier integrates directly with your Google Account using official Google APIs. We access only the minimum information necessary to provide our service:

  • Account Information: Basic profile details (such as your Google account email address and name) provided during sign-in to identify your session.
  • Google Classroom Data: Access to your Google Classroom courses, coursework, assignments, and topics strictly to read source course content and duplicate it to target courses per your request.
  • Google Drive Data: Temporary access to Google Drive files attached to your Classroom courses strictly for the purpose of copying and linking those resources to your newly created courses.

3. How We Use Your Information

We use your data exclusively to execute the operations you explicitly request, including:

  • Authenticating your account.
  • Fetching existing course structures and duplicating them into new Google Classroom courses.
  • Copying attached Google Drive materials to organize them for your new classes.

We do NOT:

  • Sell, rent, or trade your personal data or Google user data to any third parties.
  • Use your Google data for advertising, marketing, or targeting purposes.
  • Store your Google Drive files or Google Classroom contents on our servers beyond what is necessary to process your immediate requests.

4. Data Retention and Storage

We do not maintain a permanent database of your Google Classroom or Drive contents.

Access tokens received via Google OAuth are stored encrypted and used solely to perform actions on your behalf. They are refreshed as needed so you don't have to reconnect your account every session.

We retain a record of the transfers you run (courses, dates, and per-item outcomes) so you can review a job's history and resume an interrupted transfer. These records contain no Google Drive file contents or Classroom material.

You may revoke Classroom Copier's access to your Google Account at any time via your Google Account Third-Party Security Settings.

5. Third-Party Services

Classroom Copier runs using cloud hosting services (such as Render) to handle API requests securely. These infrastructure providers process data in accordance with strict security standards and only as necessary to run our application.

6. Security

We implement standard security measures to protect your information, including encrypted transmission via HTTPS. However, no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure.

7. Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated revision date.

8. Contact Us

If you have any questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy or how your data is handled, please contact us at:

Email: davidcpickett@gmail.com
